purification.name: Heart Bond
purification.how: Corruption −5 per battle the Pokémon participates in without fainting; −10 if it lands the finishing blow
purification.limits: Needs Tier ≤3; the Pokémon must have Bond ≥ Friendly

purification.name: Calming Rite
purification.how: A rest-node ritual: spend 1 Herb/Charm to drop Corruption −20
purification.limits: Once per rest node; scales with Chemistry (+5 per chemistry partner on the team)

purification.name: Rival's Word
purification.how: If the Pokémon belongs to a team the rival once opposed, the rival can speak to it (rival memory required)
purification.limits: Drops Corruption −25 once; changes rival Attitude +1

purification.name: Mentor Bind
purification.how: Link to a Clear Pokémon (the Mentor); each turn together, Corruption −2 for the Shadow, +1 Fatigue for the Mentor
purification.limits: Mentor's Bond ≥ 3; max 1 Mentor per Shadow (see §7)

purification.name: Site Cleansing
purification.how: Visit a hidden Purification Site (one per region, found via Intel or Sightings)
purification.limits: Costs a node; drops Corruption by 40–100 depending on the site's condition

purification.name: Team Reversal
purification.how: Defeat the team's lieutenant/commander who bound it; the binding weakens
purification.limits: −30 Corruption; not available if the binder is a Leader whose Doctrine is active

purification.name: Choose to Release
purification.how: Release the Pokémon into the wild; it is **not** lost: it returns as a rare wild encounter in the same region with the Shadow cleared and 50% chance to join if the player is kind
purification.limits: Costs the Pokémon from the party; may become an ally later
